Stylized manga heroic sculpted face, smoothly modeled color planes, clean graphic shapes, large grouped flowing cloth folds. NOT photorealism, film still, pores, gritty splattered oil painting or tiny broken brush flecks. Mature Guan Yu BEFORE fame: humble unknown green-mung-bean seller, old faded plain green civilian robe and simple green cloth headwrap, long dark beard, phoenix eyes, angular strong face. No armor, weapon, horse, ornaments on Guan Yu. MAIN STORY: selling mung beans to survive while deeply concerned about war and the suffering of the people. His BRIGHT CLEAR FACE AND EXPRESSIVE EYES ARE FIRST FOCAL POINT: thoughtful, vigilant, restrained heroic responsibility. He is not looking down at work or absorbed in shopkeeping. Work has stopped because events outside have his full attention. Green mung bean baskets, weighing/packing tools and small copper coins prominently establish active trade stall. Separate face silhouette from props. Keep complete headwrap below y=180px and top 180px background only. Restrained blue-shadow atmosphere and clear warm face illumination, green robes read brightly. Almost invisible tiny short cyan spirit-wisp behind distant eaves, no visible dragon head/body or monster. CONCEPT01: Three-quarter SIDE FULL-LENGTH composition, Guan Yu at left of bean stall, held weighing scale frozen mid-air in his right hand, other hand paused beside the bean pan. He turns his head and leans one ear slightly toward a traveler's grave account of war; his phoenix eyes sharply focused on the speaker, brows drawn with concern, lips firmly closed. Small secondary traveler at RIGHT foreground, back toward viewer, one plain cloth shoulder and gesturing hand visible, never obscuring Guan Yu's face. Low crowded humble street, woven baskets piled with unmistakable small green mung beans at right bottom, stall canopy overhead. Story is hearing grave news with the scale forgotten, not a normal sales conversation. Strong side-oriented composition, figure feet visible, face remains large and visually strongest.
